liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Touch of Grey** (2 reviews): Early version with some fumbles in lyric sync, though nothing too bad; Opening second set with Touch of Grey into Women Are Smarter is called rare [16][22]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Highlight of first set; Billy's drumming sounds lethargic, as if he were staring off into space [15]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Phil's bass makes fart-like sounds during this song [15]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Uncle John's Band into Playin' sequence great [16]
- **Playin' in the Band** (1 review): Second-set Playin' floats off but doesn't quite reach space [15]

## The recordings

- **gd83-04-10.sbd.harrell.16579.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 132 min; rated 4.16/5 by 19 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds fresh and clean; reviewer says it compensates for a predictable setlist [16]
- **gd1983-04-10.141631.jvcbinaural.executive-crew.holbrook.flac2448**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 128 min [2]. Said about its sound: Occasional dropouts, likely from transfer or age issues; Occasional low-frequency blurts from Phil's bass, attributed to contact issues with his new pickups [2]
- **gd1983-04-10.162697.senn421.blend.vita.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 20 songs; 129 min [6]
- **gd83-04-10.senn441.unknown.14191.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 126 min; rated 4.35/5 by 17 [11]. Said about its sound: Unknown audience recording sounds good, though reviewer prefers the soundboard; it conveys the crowd's feeling; Audience tape clearly captures the electric exchange between band and crowd during the second set; Reviewer says the sound on this audience recording is awesome [17][19][23]
- **gd1983-04-10.137677.set2.nak300.schley.flac1644**: audience recording; 11 songs; 73 min [12]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the venue was really the WVU Coliseum, and that no Morgantown Civic Center exists [14]
- Attendee says the second set was outstanding [18]
- A fan up front called for Dark Star after Sugar Magnolia [19]
- Brent's carnival-like keyboards and Jerry's soaring noodling stood out [19]
- Fan says it was second show of the tour; many skipped it, staying in Hampton to party [20]
- Travelers drove overnight, found snow in the mountains at 6 am, and a friend dove into a creek for a frisbee [20]
- First set had a Western theme [22]
- Reviewer was touring spring 1983 while supposedly looking at colleges [23]
- First set fairly standard, but the second set stands out; described as a scarce West Virginia Dead show [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd83-04-10.sbd.harrell.16579.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 1 SBD > PCM > Dat x 2 > CDR > SHN [1]. Also: Set 1 soundboard went to PCM, then DAT twice, CDR, SHN; set 2 came via cassette master, via Bob Harrell [1]
- **gd1983-04-10.141631.jvcbinaural.executive-crew.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew: Kyle Holbrook, Olvy Johnson, Mike Yacavone; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: flac24/48 Source Audience Recording: JVC200E Binaural headphone microphones Location: 80 feet from stage|Right corner of SBD ~ 20' ROC [2]
- **gd1983-04-10.162697.senn421.blend.vita.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; 3 x Sennheiser 421 mics (15th row, center) > unknown mixer > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [6]. Also: Master cassettes came from Jim Vita; Charlie Miller did the transfer; a Nakamichi 300 source patches 47 seconds of Drums [6]
- **gd83-04-10.senn441.unknown.14191.sbeok.shnf**: source: Sennheiser 441-->Sony D6 [11]
- **gd1983-04-10.137677.set2.nak300.schley.flac1644**: taped by Brian Schley; transferred by Andrew F.; source: 2nd Set AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90, FOB recording by Brian Schley. [12]. Also: A patch from another source covers Drums from 2:11 to 6:47 [12]
